title: ExportLanguageResourcesOnly, `de`, a stock List
exercises: LP-120 to LP-125, LP-142: a List and its Value relationships asked for `label_de`. Stock values have no translation, so the answer holds empty i18n elements and the reshaping keeps only what locates the item.
note: Recorded while dev had the Languages `en`, `de` and `fr` (added for the recording and deleted again afterwards). Stock items carry no `de` or `fr` values, so every translated slot of the answer is empty.
